mechanism.summary: Rewrite ordinary LoadLocal, StoreLocal, and AssignLocal instructions to appended direct-local variants only in the existing same-offset lowered execution stream when static bytecode analysis proves that the slot is frame-local, non-captured, and compatible with the operation. Add every rewritten slot to the lowered variant's required-authority mask, so one frame-entry compatibility check replaces the repeated dynamic-scope, authority, and mutability guards in the hot dispatch loop; TDZ, malformed-stack, and other exceptional states still fall back to the canonical binding helpers.
mechanism.generality: The rewrite is derived solely from immutable bytecode local metadata, capture and dynamic-scope analysis, operation kind, and the frame's authoritative-slot mask. It applies to every eligible function and never inspects source paths, benchmark or function names, property names, value contents, iteration counts, checksums, or expected results. Original bytecode, specialized loop plans, captured bindings, received upvalues, global and module bindings, direct eval and with scopes, class capture boundaries, and every frame that fails the authority mask retain the existing local opcodes and binding paths.
semantic_risks: proving direct authority for parameters and ordinary locals without admitting captured slots, received upvalues, sloppy global fallbacks, eval-deletable bindings, or class capture uncertainty
selecting the lowered stream only when the live frame authoritative mask covers every rewritten slot, including generator setup and resume
preserving temporal-dead-zone ReferenceErrors and immutable-binding TypeErrors by retaining canonical fallback for uninitialized or unsupported states
preserving stack-underflow errors and instruction-pointer synchronization when a direct store or assignment cannot complete
keeping original bytecode and specialized numeric, mutation, and control loop plan recognition unchanged
appending opcode variants without changing the size of Op or producing a dispatch-layout regression larger than the saved guards
